name: Grand Hyatt Melbourne
positioning: Grand Hyatt hotel on Collins Street in central Melbourne, with skyline and Yarra River views through floor-to-ceiling windows and a Grand Club Lounge on the 31st floor
best_for: Travelers who want a Collins Street base within walking distance of the theatre, sporting and business districts
Guests who want Club access with panoramic skyline views
Families who want connecting rooms or convertible sofa beds

facts.text: The hotel is on Collins Street, surrounded by the city's high fashion and fine dining, and within walking distance of the business, sporting and theatre districts.
The Regent Theatre is 0.24 miles from the hotel.
Flinders Street Railway Station is 0.5 kilometres from the hotel.
Several tram routes run along Collins Street.
Rooms feature generous workspaces, custom king beds and Egyptian cotton linens.
Rooms come with Balmain bath amenities, bathrobes and slippers.
Club rooms sit on the top levels of the hotel and include access to the Grand Club Lounge.
Connecting rooms and rooms with convertible sofa beds are offered to families on request, subject to availability.
Ru-Co Bar is tucked away in a city laneway, with a cocktail culture inspired by Melbourne.
The Chef's Table at Collins Kitchen is positioned directly off the show kitchen.
The hotel offers digital check-in and a digital key.

highlights.text: The Grand Club Lounge on the 31st floor offers panoramic views of the Melbourne city skyline.
All rooms and suites have Italian marble bathrooms and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Melbourne skyline or the Yarra River.
The Diplomatic Suite overlooks the Yarra River and the Melbourne skyline and has an Italian marble bathroom with a sunken spa tub.
The Grand Suite King has 180-degree views of the city.
Collins Kitchen celebrates cooking over smoke and flame with locally sourced produce.

considerations.text: Valet parking is unavailable; self-parking is nearby.
Advance reservations are highly recommended for the hotel's dining venues.
WhataHotel notes the busy urban setting may not appeal to guests seeking a tranquil atmosphere.
